  PROBLEM: The prior-status allowlist can prevent recovery of an already-merged final PR, even though that path always restores the status to `in_progress`.
  WHY: Legacy failures with no usable saved or trusted prior status remain failed and incur repeated history reads; severity was MAJOR for three reviewers and HIGH for qwen_qwen3_7-plus, so the highest applies.

  PROBLEM: Recovery proceeds with success announcements and returns success even when posting or updating the durable tracking state fails.
  WHY: A failed state POST can leave the durable state as failed while recovery comments and notifications are sent repeatedly; ignored completion-status PATCH failures can also leave tracking updates missing or incomplete.

  WHY: The inaccurate references mislead maintainers verifying test coverage; this was reported as NIT.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11423-11444 | severity=low | confidence=[3]

  PROBLEM: When `UNBLOCK_TRUSTED_LOGIN` is empty, the trusted-snapshot fallback does not run, so an older failure without `integration_failed_from_status` cannot recover during the identity outage.
  WHY: Recovery is delayed until identity resolution succeeds again; reviewers classified this as NIT.

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- File: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh
  Line or code reference: `recover_failed_integration_if_mergeable`, the block after `restored_status` is computed (around lines 11463-11476 — `post_state_comment || true` followed by `post_tracking_comment`, `update_completion_status_comment ... || true`, `tg_notify`, the `outcome=recovered` log, and `return 10`).
  severity=MAJOR confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Recovery is announced even when persisting the recovered state to the durable V2 comment chain fails; the state POST and completion-status PATCH failures are ignored.
  WHY: The poller reloads state from the V2 chain at the start of each tick (around line 21118), so a failed state POST leaves durable state failed and triggers repeated recovery comments, PATCHes, and notifications.
- File: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh
  Line or code reference: `recover_failed_integration_if_mergeable`, the trusted-snapshot fallback around lines 11423-11442 — the inner `if [ -z "${prior_status}" ] && [ -n "${UNBLOCK_TRUSTED_LOGIN:-}" ]; then`.
  severity=NIT confidence=3
  PROBLEM: When `UNBLOCK_TRUSTED_LOGIN` is empty, neither the V2 `extract --skip-status failed` call nor the legacy V1 comment walk runs.
  WHY: An older failure that predates `integration_failed_from_status` cannot recover during the identity outage and stays failed with `outcome=skip reason=prior_status_unknown`.
- File: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh
  Line or code reference: `recover_failed_integration_if_mergeable`, the trusted-snapshot fallback around lines 11423-11442 and the `case "${prior_status}"` at lines 11442-11444.
  severity=NIT confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The prior-status allowlist is evaluated even when `recovery_reason="final_pr_merged"`, although the merged path forces the restored status to `in_progress`.
  WHY: A legacy failure can stay failed with `outcome=skip reason=prior_status_unknown`, and the V2/V1 lookup is dead work on the merged branch.
- File: tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py
  Line or code reference: `test_failed_integration_project_stays_failed_until_the_final_pr_is_mergeable` (the skip-reasons matrix around lines 24979-24995) versus the `fetch_failed` skip reason in `recover_failed_integration_if_mergeable` (lines 11399-11402 of the script).
  severity=NIT confidence=3
  PROBLEM: No test exercises the `fetch_failed` skip reason when `git fetch --no-tags origin ...` returns non-zero.
  WHY: The branch correctly skips recovery, but a future change to it would have no test pinning the behavior.
